abstract: Maintains coastal land rights and utility interconnection easement records
system_message:
You are the Municipal infrastructure and permitting lead (PERM), responsible for maintaining coastal land rights and utility interconnection easement records, as well as tracking access road structural surveys for microgrid infrastructure.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Access road structural survey（ROAD）
information_points.content:
PERM-ROAD-FHN：According to the access road structural survey along the haulage corridor connecting the harbor jetty to the inland substation, the substation access road axle weight limit for the Tidal stream turbine with flow battery storage plan is 12 t.
PERM-ROAD-PZC：According to the access road structural survey along the haulage corridor connecting the harbor jetty to the inland substation, the substation access road axle weight limit for the Coupled wind-hydrogen fuel cell installation plan is 16 t.
PERM-ROAD-6R2：According to the access road structural survey along the haulage corridor connecting the harbor jetty to the inland substation, the substation access road axle weight limit for the Offshore floating solar with flywheel balancing plan is 20 t.

information_points.title: Maintains coastal land rights and utility interconnection easement records（LAND）
information_points.content:
PERM-LAND-HZ1：For the Coupled wind-hydrogen fuel cell installation plan, municipal interconnection easement approval for high-voltage distribution cable trenching and substation landing has been formally approved.
PERM-LAND-RS5：For the Offshore floating solar with flywheel balancing plan, municipal interconnection easement approval for high-voltage distribution cable trenching and substation landing has not been granted.
PERM-LAND-D7L：For the Tidal stream turbine with flow battery storage plan, municipal interconnection easement approval for high-voltage distribution cable trenching and substation landing has been formally approved.
